notes: Verified against the source on 2026-11-19. The post calls sealed sender an incremental step toward hiding who is messaging whom, and names network metadata and timing correlation as ongoing work.

promises.why: The sender certificate travels inside an envelope encrypted to the recipient; the service receives the message unauthenticated.
The envelope hides the sender cryptographically, but the service still sees the recipient and network metadata (IP, timing); the post calls it incremental.
Delivery tokens derived from the recipient's profile key replace sender authentication; the optional 'receive from anyone' setting trades this away, which the post flags as an abuse risk.

keywords_note: Each keyword is a case-insensitive regex; a ledger promise matches when every keyword matches its 'promise' text. A list of verdicts means any of them is accepted.
